conceptual assets.information: The setting requests whether the clock-enable divider runs, and the generator's behavior depends on this request.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity: The setting is stored in en from enable_i at line 129, so changing the request changes the control state that governs the divider. Availability: en gates counter advancement at line 130 and causes cnt to reset at lines 131-134, which can withhold all generated clock enables.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could force enable_i inactive or corrupt the stored en value, stopping the divider and withholding required clock enables.

conceptual assets.information: The information is the periodic and divided clock-enable pulse schedule on clk_en_o, which downstream logic uses for timing. It has no entry port because it is produced from internal divider state.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity: The pulse values are produced by the divider state through the assignments at lines 140-147, so corruption of cnt or cnt2 can alter the schedule. Availability: The enable-controlled counter behavior at lines 130-134 can stop the state transitions that generate the output pulses at lines 140-147.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could corrupt the divider state or disable its operation so that downstream logic receives incorrect or no clock-enable pulses.

considered, not kept.reason: The clocks-and-resets rule excludes reset requests, registered reset-release chains, their copies, and reset output ports; lines 44-73 implement only those functions.
rstn_wdt_i only gates the system reset chain and is copied to a reset output at lines 54-57 and 72, so the reset rule excludes it as a conceptual asset.
rstn_dbg_i only gates the system reset chain and is copied to a reset output at lines 54-57 and 73, so the reset rule excludes it as a conceptual asset.
clk_i only times the reset synchronizer processes at lines 42-73, and the clocks-and-resets rule excludes clock inputs as conceptual assets.
clk_i only times the ticker at lines 122-128, and the clocks-and-resets rule excludes clock inputs as conceptual assets.
rstn_i only resets en, cnt and cnt2 at lines 124-127, and the clocks-and-resets rule excludes reset inputs as conceptual assets.
